identifier_in_source.description: Ticker or CUSIP of the affected security, exactly as the source prints it. For a bond with no CUSIP printed, the coupon and maturity as printed

event_type.description: One of: reverse split, forward split, ticker change, name change, ADS ratio change, redemption, tender offer, other

terms.description: Split or ratio terms, or redemption price and amount, as stated

effective_as_stated.description: Effective date and time exactly as the source writes it

market_effective_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the first trading day on the new terms, or the redemption date for a bond, or not stated

new_cusip.description: New CUSIP as stated, or not stated

new_symbol.description: New ticker as stated, or not stated

source_notice_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD printed on the notice itself
